lines: The wind's willing to stop. Your ears aim better than your bow.
The coast is still roaring. Go or don't — that's yours. The company doesn't order you there.
Swiftshadow won't wait for titles. The real body will, for one short beat.
Don't chase the afterimages. Wait for the pause, then shoot. Better than a pretty medal.
The forest knows footsteps, not titles. You walk slowly. That's good. Weakest of the company? The woods only know the pause.
